## Proposed filename

New pages need a **new filename**. Do **not** rename, move, or reuse the frozen PFRA Tracker policy:

- File: `PrivacyPolicy.html` (repo root, path unchanged)
- Frozen URL: https://devioshdev.github.io/PFRATracker/PrivacyPolicy.html

## Notes

- This repo is the public GitHub Pages compliance/support host, not app source.
- Do not invent unpublished App Store URLs.
- Pages smoke check (`.github/workflows/pages-smoke-check.yml`) must still pass after the page is added.
